messages.subject: Facet_wrap
parts:
Dear all,

I have having a little problem with the facet_wrap. Facet_grid is working but not what I need. Below is a reproducable example illustrating the problem. I am sure it is something obvious but I am not sure what is going wrong here.

Cheers,

Phil




x <- rnorm (24, mean = 0, sd = .4)
y <- rnorm (24, mean = 0, sd = .4)
group <- as.factor(c (rep('a',6), rep('b',6), rep('c',6), rep('d',6) ) )
my_data <- data.frame (group, x, y)

library(ggplot2)
lm_smooth <- geom_smooth (method = lm, size = 1, fill = 'black', se = FALSE, colour = "black")

fac_grid<- qplot(x, y, data = my_data) + lm_smooth  + facet_grid(~ group) #works
fac_wrap<- qplot(x, y, data = my_data) + lm_smooth  + facet_wrap(~ group, nrow = 2) #does not work

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: Re: Facet_wrap
parts:
The problem appears to be a name conflict centered on 'group'. If you
change the name of that variable to 'grp' your second example works.
Remember that ggplot uses the term 'group' as an aesthetic, so you
should avoid naming variables using the same strings that ggplot uses
for aesthetics. I've run into similar problems with variables named
'start' when plotting dates, as ggplot appears to use some time series
functions with arguments named 'start'.
